Kind: captions
Language: en

NOTE
Roll-up captions, the shape BL-28 measured: two lines scroll on screen and the
track emits one cue per DISPLAY FRAME rather than one per line of speech. Every
line therefore arrives three times — alone, as the tail of the previous frame,
and as the head of the next — and each solo cue is followed 0.01s later by the
frame that adds the line after it. Synthetic words, measured geometry (R21).
The last cue is a frame, so the final line never appears alone anywhere in this
file: it exists only as that frame's tail.
